summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Changes: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new; load_decathalon_datalist plus private _resolve_path helper), monai/data/__init__.py (explicit export after the utils wildcard import), docs/source/data.rst (Decathalon DataLoader subsection with tilde underline and autofunction entry), and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py (new; TestLoadDecathalonDatalist with four tests, each removing its temp directory in finally). Nothing was committed and no tests or repository code were run, per instructions. Verification was by reading only, plus a scan confirming no line exceeds 120 columns. Choices: typing is imported for annotations (spec said only os and json, but Python 3.9 needs typing for Optional); non-object top-level JSON and non-list key values raise ValueError; empty strings are not rejected.
